description: Pinned centerpiece result of the payoff calculator: debt-free date (hero), 3 metric cells (time/interest/total cost), and a savings callout vs $0 extra. The only floating card and only h1 on the screen. Recomputes live as levers change.

extraPayment.description: Current extra monthly payment; callout renders only when > 0 and monthsSaved > 0

content.neverPayableNudge: Minimum payments barely cover interest — try adding an extra payment.
content.emptySelection: Pick at least one debt below to see your payoff.

accessibility.label: Debt-free by {payoffDate}, {totalMonths} months from now. Time to pay {totalMonths} months. Interest {totalInterest}. Total cost {totalCost}. Adding {extraPayment} a month saves {monthsSaved} months and {interestSaved} in interest.
accessibility.colorIndependence: interest cost pairs '+' prefix and alert-circle-outline with red; never-payable pairs icon+word with color
accessibility.reducedMotion: hero cross-fade becomes instant value swap

notes: Compute base = computePayoff(focusedDebts, 0, strategy) memoized on [focusedDebts, strategy] to derive monthsSaved/interestSaved without recomputing on every keystroke.
